mathematics.assertion_tested: Lean kernel acceptance of first-order root motion for actual square polynomial systems G=F+p^M H over p-adic integers, starting from F(a)=0 and a rationally invertible actual original Jacobian DF(a) with inverse denominator bound s; existence and uniqueness in the full p^(s+1) ball, displacement depth M-s, and the exact rational first-order formula with integral error of depth 2M-3s when M>2s; inherited lifting and chart theorems; expanded statement contracts and mathematically invalid controls
mathematics.coefficient_domain: New motion theorem: finite square polynomial systems F,H over Z_p, an arbitrary exact base root a in Z_p^d, prime p, and natural s,M; first-order identity is in Q_p with an explicitly integral error. Inherited rectangular chart interfaces retain their integer coefficient hypotheses
mathematics.conventions: Prime p; natural s,M with M>2s; J is the actual evaluated derivative of original F at a, not a supplied surrogate and not the perturbed Jacobian; p^s J inverse has integral entries, equivalent to A J = J A = p^s I; G=F+p^M H; uniqueness ball exponent s+1, displacement exponent M-s, first-order error exponent 2M-3s
non_claims: Invariance under arbitrary polynomial presentation changes
Rank-nullity cardinality formulas over composite moduli
